response.description:
Updated: Microsoft’s support lifecycle is evolving
in alignment with VMware’s roadmap. Broadcom will end support for the current
AV36 VCF version on September 30, 2027, and the AV36 SKU is not compatible with
VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) 9, the next-generation platform.As part of this transition, and to align with the AVS License-include service retirement, all AV36 SDDCs will be
retired after August 30, 2027, regardless of individual RI expiration
dates. On August 31, 2027, these SDDCs will no longer be accessible.Key dates for existing AV36 subscriptionsJune 30, 2026 Last day to
buy a 1-year RI for AV36 VCF BYOL August 30, 2027 AV36 SKU Retirement and AVS License-included service retirementAugust 31, 2027 AV36 SDDC
access will be removed. Microsoft will retain the data for up to 60 days so the
customer can retrieve it.Reach out to your Microsoft
Account Team for key dates for AV36 PayGo subscriptions.Recommended action:At this time, we recommend that you review your current AV36
SDDCs and then work with your Microsoft Account Team. Identify
available AVS node types on the Azure Product by Region page and visit
the AVS Documentation page to learn
about HCX migrations between AVS node types.Help and support: If you have questions, please reach out to your Microsoft
Account Team.
response.title: Retirement: Azure VMware Solution AV36 node End of Support now August 30, 2027
